text:
morgan: Heads-up — scheduling a "silent surge" shadow-drain tonight 00:30 UTC to exercise spillover routing and KV-cache priming. low-traffic window, expected duration ~45m. Staggered single-node drains across az-west2 (approx 10% pool).
ops-bot: Maintenance scheduled for pool 'az-west2-gpu' at 2026-03-24T00:30Z. No planned customer downtime; rolling node cordons + warm reboots.
sam: Whats the expected capacity hit? exact # GPUs?
morgan: ~12 GPUs out of service across 6 nodes. Sequence: cordon -> drain (5m) -> reboot -> kv-seed -> verify -> next. Parallelism=1 to keep tail sane.
jia: Can we pin dedicated tenant routes to az-east1-burst to avoid p99 tail spikes for SLA customers?
morgan: Yes, routing policy will move label:dedicated -> az-east1-burst for the window. sam, can you confirm burst pool headroom?
sam: Confirmed ~15% spare for the next 2h. We'll also allow preemptible backfill for best-effort workloads.
luis: Cost note: if we enable az-east1 burst itll add ~ $0.6k/hr for GPUs under this configuration. Need quick approval?
emily: Finance green for emergencies up to $1k/hr this quarter. For planned ops we need a JIRA ticket to tag costs to PG.
morgan: Opening ticket now and tagging cost center. Also KV seed script well run after each reboot: 
```bash
./tools/kv-seed --pool az-west2-gpu --nodes 6 --parallel 1
```
ops-bot: Preflight checks passed. Canary nodes selected: gpu-node-21, gpu-node-34. Health probes ok.
sam: What are rollback criteria?
morgan: Abort and reverse if p50 latency increases >25% OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 10m. Uncordon in reverse order and stop the window. I'll stream the metrics to #eng-runtime during the run.
jia: Add a cross-AZ egress capacity check — last time we saw ~100ms spikes when bursting traffic.
sam: I'll keep dashboards on watch, will escalate at first sign. Ping me 15m before start.
morgan: Will send 15m ping. :bell:
emily: Comms: Dedicated customers get an automated email 1h prior via comms-bot. Ops note: include fallback endpoints and expected impact.
comms-bot: Email queued to dedicated-customers@redwood.com for 2026-03-24T00:30Z (template: maintenance_shadow_drain_v1).
luis: One more ops ask: avoid nodes with nvlink fw rev 3xx (they take longer to come back on warm reboot). Exclude them from canary.
morgan: Acknowledged. Updated runbook to --exclude-serial 3xx and updated the script.
sam: Monitoring handoff in place. Ready to proceed once ticket is up. :eyes:
